title: Decoration Automation Failure Rate
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=holidaytimer:event
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(status="success")) as successful by _time zone_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for decoration automation runs by zone.
value: Failure rate keeps the novelty setup maintainable instead of leaving you to rediscover which plug or automation broke.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for decoration automation runs events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for decoration automation runs by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how often decoration automation runs works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
